units.source_text: 次年夏天，六条院池中莲花盛开之时，尼僧三公主家庭供奉的佛像完成了，举行开光典礼。

en.t: The following summer, when the lotus flowers were in full bloom in the pond at Rokujo-in, the Buddhist images to be enshrined in the household of the Third Princess, now a nun, were completed, and an eye-opening consecration ceremony was held.

units.source_text: 此次由源氏主办，经堂中各种用具，置办得十分周到，迅速着手布置装饰。

en.t: Genji sponsored the ceremony, and the various furnishings for the sutra hall were prepared with great care, so the work of arranging and decorating began at once.

units.source_text: 佛前悬挂的幢幡，形色非常优美，是特选中国织锦缝制的。

en.t: The banners hung before the Buddha were exceptionally graceful in shape and color, sewn from specially selected Chinese brocade.

units.source_text: 这工作全由紫夫人担任。

en.t: Lady Murasaki took charge of all this work.

units.source_text: 花盆架上的毡子，用美丽的凸星花纹织物，雅致可爱，色泽也很鲜丽，是世间罕见的珍品。

en.t: The felt covering on the flower-stand was made of a beautiful raised star-patterned fabric, elegant and charming, with vivid coloring, a rare treasure in the world.

units.source_text: 寝台四角的帐幕都撩起，内供佛像。

en.t: The curtains at the four corners of the dais were all drawn up, and the Buddhist images were enshrined within.

units.source_text: 后方悬挂法华曼陀罗图；佛前供设银花瓶，内插高大鲜艳的莲花。

en.t: Behind them hung a Lotus Sutra mandala, and before the Buddha stood silver vases holding tall, brilliant lotus flowers.

units.source_text: 所焚的香是中国舶来的“百步香”。

en.t: The incense burned there was Hundred-Pace Incense brought by ship from China.

units.source_text: 中央所供的阿弥陀佛像及侍立两旁的观世音菩萨像、大势至菩萨像，都用白檀木雕成，非常精致美丽。

en.t: The image of Amida Buddha enshrined in the center, together with the figures of the bodhisattvas Kannon and Seishi standing attendant on either side, were all carved from white sandalwood and were exquisitely beautiful.

units.source_text: 供净水的器皿照例很精小，上面放着青、白、紫色的人造小莲花。

en.t: The vessels for offering pure water were, as usual, small and finely made, with tiny artificial lotus flowers in blue, white, and purple placed upon them.

units.source_text: 又有根据古代“荷叶”香调制法调配而成的名香，其中隐隐加入蜂蜜，焚时与百步香合流，香气异常馥郁。

en.t: There was also a renowned incense blended according to the ancient Lotus Leaf formula, with a faint touch of honey added; when burned, it mingled with the Hundred-Pace Incense and gave off an extraordinarily rich fragrance.

units.source_text: 佛经为六道众生分写六部。

en.t: The sutras were copied in six sets, one for the beings of each of the six realms.

units.source_text: 三公主自用的佛经，由源氏亲手书写，附有愿文，大意是：今生仅能以此结缘，他年誓当携手同登极乐净土。

en.t: The sutra for the Third Princess herself was written by Genji in his own hand and accompanied by a vow, whose meaning was that in this life they could only form this bond through it, but in a future life they vowed to join hands and ascend together to the Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss.

units.source_text: 又有《阿弥陀经》，因中国纸质地脆弱，朝夕持诵易于损坏，故特地宣召纸屋院工人，郑重叮嘱，令其加工制造最优名纸。

en.t: There was also a copy of the Amida Sutra; because Chinese paper was fragile and would easily be damaged by morning and evening recitation, Genji specially summoned craftsmen from the Paper Office and earnestly instructed them to make the finest possible paper.

units.source_text: 源氏从今春开始就用心书写。

en.t: Genji had been writing it with great care since the spring of that year.

units.source_text: 窥见一端的人，已觉光彩炫目。

en.t: Anyone who caught even a glimpse of a small part of it was already dazzled by its radiance.

units.source_text: 因为源氏的笔墨，比打格子的金线更加辉煌灿烂，真乃稀世之宝。

en.t: For Genji's brushwork shone even more brilliantly than the gold lines ruled across the page, making it truly a treasure rarely seen in the world.

units.source_text: 至于经卷的轴、裱纸、箱，其精美自不待言。

en.t: As for the scroll rollers, mounting papers, and boxes, their exquisite workmanship went without saying.

units.source_text: 这经卷安置在一张沉香木制、足上雕花的几上，装饰在供佛像的寝台内。

en.t: The scrolls were placed on a small table made of aloeswood, with flowers carved on its legs, and displayed within the dais where the Buddhist images were enshrined.
